scope: Fresh independent source-only review of the SVG native acceptance runner and its native side-panel harness cleanup. No browser, build, or test was launched in this lane.

evidence: The runner's expected article sequence includes each section heading, its own SVG, caption, and label, then the next section; the later sections cannot satisfy earlier ordered slots.
Each rendered SVG must be complete with positive natural dimensions. Its decoded data URI is checked for the expected path and three expected rectangle geometries, including the deep-mode revision.

Deep mode edits the source caption, bar geometry, and a unique paragraph only after Fast capture. The wait requires the changed caption and unique paragraph in the rendered article before accepting Deep.
The runner creates test-results before invoking the harness, so missing release receipt, artifact mismatch, or runtime preflight errors can still be written as structured unverified reports.
verdict_a_runtime_and_fixture_coverage.reason: These are source guarantees only. The guarded native browser execution and observed rendered output remain with the root lane.

positive_evidence: The previously identified interleaving, geometry, deep freshness race, and preflight report-directory gaps are addressed in the current runner.
Harness teardown detaches its own CDP connection, closes its own localhost server, stops only its spawned Chrome child, and removes its own temporary profile root. It does not issue Browser.close.
still_open_limits: The SVG checks are source-payload geometry checks plus browser image load dimensions; they do not prove colors or visual appearance by screenshot inspection.

The deep freshness signal proves the revised fixture content reached the rendered article, but does not independently identify a capture-generation token or prove behavior for arbitrary page mutations.
A passing fixture remains evidence for this owned localhost article through the tested Fast and Deep flows. It does not prove an unrelated public production page or full EXT-F-1007-T28 breadth.
If creating test-results itself fails, the runner cannot write its report; that is a filesystem failure before the harness and outside its structured preflight reporting path.

prior_findings.evidence: renderedArticle emits text and image nodes in TreeWalker order; assertArticle checks an ordered sequence across both figures.
Image complete/natural dimensions are required, and decoded SVG path/rect geometry is asserted.
Deep-only caption and paragraph are inserted after Fast, and the rendered article must contain both; there is no transient Scrolling-state poll.
Output directory creation precedes runNativeSidepanelQa; catch/finally writes status, stage, and bounded failure detail.
Harness cleanup targets the locally owned CDP connection, server, spawned child, and temporary root; runner closes only its owned fixture server.

conclusion: Source review supports proceeding to the root-owned guarded native acceptance. Runtime outcome remains unverified in this lane.
